text.en: Dog owners highly value Kerry for her knowledgeable, approachable, and encouraging coaching style. Handlers praise her ability to educate owners clearly, turning beginners into confident handlers with practical homework exercises. Reviewers appreciate her thorough pre-session questionnaires and prompt written follow-up reports.

Clients consistently report remarkable progress in puppy obedience, trick learning, and resolving unwanted habits at home. Handlers note that targeted techniques deliver quick, observable improvements in dog focus and manners. Dogs return from group lessons mentally stimulated, content, and noticeably better behaved.

Reviewers emphasize the positive, engaging atmosphere maintained during the Wigglebutts puppy and dog classes. Small group sizes of around six dogs ensure that every dog receives individualized attention without feeling overwhelmed. Handlers highlight how much their dogs look forward to the interactive exercises and treats.

q.en: How large are the training group classes?

a.en: Reviewers note that group classes are kept small, typically limited to around six dogs to allow individual coaching.

q.en: Are structured puppy training packages offered?

a.en: Yes, clients mention comprehensive puppy packages that provide foundation skills, practical advice, and ongoing guidance.

q.en: Do owners receive written reports after training sessions?

a.en: Yes, handlers report receiving detailed follow-up email breakdowns with specific exercises to practise between sessions.
